label: Phylogenetic pattern
text: BI.O.A4.4 Phylogenetic pattern. A phylogeny is a hypothesis of relationship. A clade is a common ancestor and all its descendants. Rank (family, order) is a convention (W12). Horizontal transfer and incomplete lineage sorting make gene trees differ from species trees.

warrant.standard: Phylogeny with support values; congruent independent data
warrant.defeaters: Long-branch attraction; incomplete lineage sorting; horizontal transfer
